## What and why

<!-- What does this change, and why? If it fixes an issue, write "Fixes #123". -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a conventional commit, such as `fix(git): keep the branch picker open`. It becomes the changelog entry.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated.
- [ ] The gates pass locally.
- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (DCO): commit with `git commit -s`.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the code, the commits or the screenshots.
- [ ] UI changes: a screenshot is attached.
